metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the reading, the hollow crown, Kemp at the end of it, and the leaves going out under an arm.

yesterday: The forty leaves are at Dick's.
The book goes to the Master whole, when there is a fair copy. The cutting is his.
Kemp came at the fourth act and heard the end.
The afternoon line is struck. The king was read, and the leaves are with Dick.
The horn was twopence. Supper was threepence.
